title: A differential basis for the stabilized smooth conormal chart
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, n,c natural numbers, P=R[x_1,...,x_n], f:Fin c -> P, J=span(range f), and C=P/J [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Suppose C is smooth over R [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] and a C-basis of J/J^2 indexed by Fin c is given. For every g in D=C[y_1,...,y_c], the module of Kahler differentials Omega(D_g/R) [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] has a D_g-basis indexed by Fin n [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. This statement uses no map from P to D_g and no unramifiedness assumption.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 07CH, split conormal sequence and polynomial extension; localization via Tags 00RV and 00RX, source checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CH

proof.text: Apply Algebra.FormallySmooth.iff_split_injection to the quotient P -> C. The exact conormal sequence and Function.Exact.split_tfae' give C tensor_P Omega(P/R) isomorphic to (J/J^2) times Omega(C/R). Identify the quotient kernel with J by Ideal.mk_ker and Ideal.Cotangent.equivOfEq, and extend the P-linear splitting to C using surjectivity of P -> C.

The base-changed polynomial differential basis and the given conormal basis identify C^n with Omega(C/R) times C^c. Base-change this equivalence to D. Distribute tensor products over the product and identify D tensor_C C^c with D^c using TensorProduct.equivPiOfFiniteBasis. Apply KaehlerDifferential.exists_polynomial_extension_equiv to identify the result with Omega(D/R), giving a Fin n basis.

Base-change the constructed basis along D -> D_g. The formally etale localization equivalence KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale R D D_g identifies its underlying module with Omega(D_g/R). The resulting basis is the asserted witness, with no unproved data chosen.

proof_origin.place: Linear-algebra form of the split conormal sequence in 07CH, combined with the proved polynomial-extension and localization identities.

theorem nonempty_basis_smooth_conormal_chart
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n c : ℕ) (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    [Algebra.Smooth R (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))]
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin c)
      (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))
      (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).Cotangent)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin c) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))) :
    Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) (Localization.Away g)
      (KaehlerDifferential R (Localization.Away g)))
